This implements InstantSearch.css for the `refinementList` searchbox.

At some point we should refactor the `searchbox` widget to use a single searchbox.

## Specs

https://instantsearch-css.netlify.com/widgets/refinement-list/

## Stories

https://deploy-preview-3263--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=RefinementList.with%20search%20inside%20items

Deploy preview for *instantsearchjs* ready!

Built with commit 064b141f19ad92d79f8f5a51099c6e0e2b5c1937

https://deploy-preview-3263--instantsearchjs.netlify.com

I added the `reset` behavior, @samouss. I can't get to test it correctly with Enzyme though. I'd need to set the input to something to assert that `hidden` becomes `true`. They don't seem to have a proper API to fill an input.

@francoischalifour since the input is uncontrolled the only way to test it is to directly access the input and set a value on it. Indeed they don't have an a proper API to do it but you can probably get a reference to the node and set the value directly on it.

title: feat(refinement-list): implement InstantSearch.css to searchbox
